description: Deterministic checks for Power Apps Source Code Schema component YAML. Findings complement Studio/App Checker and never replace runtime or visual gates.

rules.name: emitting-event-needs-parameters
rules.message: Event description says it emits values but the Event declares no Parameters block.

rules.name: output-needs-formula
rules.message: Output custom property has no corresponding formula in the component Properties section.

rules.name: shared-component-external-run
rules.message: Shared component directly invokes an external .Run(...) action; verify the call belongs in the host boundary.

rules.name: shared-component-data-mutation
rules.message: Shared component mutates host/business data with Patch/Collect/ClearCollect/Remove/RemoveIf; verify ownership.

rules.name: undersized-button-hit-area
rules.message: Interactive Classic/Button has a fixed hit dimension below 40 px.

rules.name: image-parent-select-only
rules.message: Interactive Image only calls Select(Parent); verify this also emits the row semantic action.

rules.name: manual-ancestor-chain-shorter-than-max-depth
rules.message: Manual pN ancestor chain is shorter than the declared MaxDepth contract.
